int_name: N BROAD ST & W CAYUGA ST

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane arterial road with a marked zebra crosswalk but no signalization or physical refuge. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long unprotected crossing distance creates significant exposure for pedestrians in a high-speed environment.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross five lanes of traffic (including the center turn lane) without a physical refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks signals or stop signs to require vehicles to yield on a high-capacity roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection of the crosswalk and the travel lanes

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracks and wear in the asphalt within the pedestrian path could present a minor trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground asphalt near the start of the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated amber LEDs to crossing signage to increase driver yielding rates at this uncontrolled location.

result.summary: The intersection features marked crosswalks and overhead traffic signals within a residential setting. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical pedestrian protection like refuge islands or curb extensions increase exposure risk for people crossing.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide expanse of asphalt without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the intersection on the left side

hazards.name: Faded pavement markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk and lane markings are visibly worn, which can reduce driver awareness of the crossing zone.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Refresh the crosswalk with high-visibility continental or ladder style markings to improve conspicuity.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane arterial road with high-visibility continental crosswalk markings. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the long unprotected crossing distance and lack of a median refuge island create a car-centric environment that is challenging for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a mid-block refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the image may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection near the crosswalk entrance

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Ensure pedestrian signals with countdown timers are installed and visible to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with essential pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks, curb ramps with tactile warnings, and dedicated pedestrian signals. However, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded, and the wide curb radii combined with poor pavement quality may compromise pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are heavily worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Wide curb radius
hazards.description: The rounded curb on the left allows for higher-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven asphalt in the roadway can create trip hazards and affect vehicle braking.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with continental or ladder-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the intersection to eliminate cracks and provide a smooth, predictable surface for all users.
